name: Wild Particles
description: v1's Wild Particles: 10000 particles of five kinds (massless and m 0.01 neutral ones, electrons, up and down quarks with charges -1, 2/3, -1/3) and random ±1 nuclear charge start in a disk of radius 100, then v1's sine nuclear force (range 1e4), Coulomb (k = 0.01) and gravity (G = 1e-3) throw them around a reflecting circle of radius 5e5. v1 gave massless particles unit inertia and no gravity; here they have mass 1.
